title: Minervit AI Delivery Bootstrap Legacy Allowlist
description: Schema for adapters/projects/.bootstrap-legacy-allowlist.json. This is a privilege-granting file: every listed adapter is grandfathered past the bootstrap-evidence requirement, so each entry must justify itself with a non-empty path, project, and reason. additionalProperties:false on the root and on each entry blocks silent typos and undocumented grants.

adapters.description: Adapters grandfathered past the bootstrap-evidence requirement. Each grant must be individually justified.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the grandfathered adapter file.

project.description: Human-readable project name the adapter belongs to.

reason.description: Why this adapter is exempt from the bootstrap-evidence requirement.
